My dear [Charlotte](/person/1587)
How shall I say how I grieve for you in this fresh sorrow so doubled as it is by all you have to care for, the poor little [Cordelia](/person/1364) I can only say.

May comfort come to you under this fresh shadow which God has thought fit to send to you and which must thus have infinite blessings within it[^1]
your loving

C M Yonge


[^1]: CMY refers to the death of Charlotte Yonge\'s daughter [Katharine (Yonge) Steer](/person/1365).
